description: This file defines a specialized exception class 'SiloUnavailableException' used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a request was canceled due to silo unavailability. It provides multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable.

classes.name: SiloUnavailableException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating silo unavailability, derived from OrleansMessageRejectionException, with multiple constructors and serialization support.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException()
methods.description: Default constructor that sets a default message indicating silo is unavailable.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(string msg)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a custom message for the exception.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a message and an inner exception, for exception chaining.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Private constructor used during serialization, marked as obsolete.
